plain.en: making new plants from its own growing parts

means.en: Growing a new plant from a part of the parent, such as a stem, a leaf or a bud, rather than from a seed. Every offspring is genetically the same as its parent.

plain.en: a piece of stem planted to grow roots

means.en: A piece of stem cut off a plant and pushed into soil, where it grows roots of its own and becomes a new plant.

plain.en: the stem piece that gives the flowers

means.en: The cut stem piece grafted onto a rooted plant. It gives everything above the join: stem, leaves and flowers.

plain.en: the rooted plant that provides the roots

means.en: In grafting, the rooted plant that gives the roots. The new stem piece is joined on top of it.

plain.en: rooting a twig while it is still joined to the parent

means.en: Bending a thin twig and burying its middle in the soil, so that it roots while still joined to the parent plant.

plain.en: the growing point at the very top of the shoot

means.en: the tip
the dividing part
The cluster of cells at the tip of a shoot, where new tissue forms. A tiny piece of it can be grown into a whole plant.

plain.en: an exact copy

means.en: branch, twig
An offspring made from a single parent, genetically the same as that parent. Clones are what vegetative propagation, budding and spore production all produce.

plain.en: the long branching threads

means.en: a web, a woven thing
The long thin threads a mould is made of. They branch and tangle into a mat, and some carry a round sac of spores.

plain.en: the round sac at the tip of a thread

means.en: seed
vessel
The little sac at the end of a hypha that holds the spores. When the sac breaks, the spores are carried away on the air.

plain.en: a tiny, light body that can grow into a new mould

means.en: seed
A tiny body, usually one cell, that floats on air currents and can grow into a new individual when it finds moisture and nutrients.

plain.en: division that gives two cells with the parent's number of chromosomes

means.en: thread
division
Cell division in which the chromosomes are copied once and split evenly, so both daughter cells come out with the same number as the parent cell.

plain.en: a thread-like structure in the nucleus carrying the genetic information

means.en: colour
body
A thread-like structure inside the nucleus that carries the genetic information. You can see chromosomes clearly only while a cell is dividing.

plain.en: holding the full set

means.en: two
a set
A cell holding the full chromosome set: 23 pairs in a human, so 46 in all. Every ordinary body cell is diploid.

plain.en: holding half a set

means.en: single, one
A cell holding half the chromosome set: one from each pair, so 23 in a human. Gametes are haploid.

plain.en: the haploid cell made for reproduction

means.en: marriage
A reproductive cell carrying half the chromosome set. Two gametes fuse to make a new individual.

plain.en: the division that halves the number of chromosomes

means.en: smaller, less
division
Cell division in which the chromosome number is halved. It makes gametes, and it mixes the chromosomes of the two parents.

plain.en: the cell the two gametes fuse into

means.en: yoked, joined together
The single cell formed when two gametes join. It carries chromosomes from both parents.

plain.en: the green outer part

means.en: One of the green parts in the outermost whorl of a flower. In a bud they cover and protect the other parts.

plain.en: the coloured part

means.en: One of the coloured parts of a flower. Their colour and scent attract insects.

plain.en: the male part of a flower

means.en: The male part of a flower: a filament with an anther on top that makes pollen grains.

plain.en: the head at the top of a stamen

means.en: flower
The head at the top of a stamen. It makes pollen grains.

plain.en: the stalk underneath

means.en: thread
The thin stalk of a stamen, below the anther.

plain.en: the female part of a flower

means.en: The female part of a flower, at its centre. It has three parts: stigma, style and ovary.

plain.en: the tip of the pistil

means.en: a mark
The tip of the pistil, flat or sticky, which receives pollen grains.

plain.en: the thin tube of the pistil

means.en: a pillar
The thin long tube that connects the stigma to the ovary. A pollen tube grows down through it.

plain.en: the swollen base of the pistil, or the organ that makes eggs

means.en: egg
In a flower, the swollen base of the pistil, holding ovules; it becomes the fruit. In humans, one of a pair of organs that make eggs and release hormones.

plain.en: a small body inside the ovary

means.en: egg
A small body inside the ovary of a flower. Each ovule has an egg cell, and it becomes a seed once fertilised.

plain.en: pollen moving from anther to stigma

means.en: pollen, fine dust
the act of
The transfer of pollen grains from an anther to a stigma.

plain.en: pollen from the same flower

means.en: Pollination where the pollen reaches the stigma of the same flower or of another flower on the same plant.

plain.en: pollen from another plant of the same kind

means.en: Pollination where pollen travels between two plants of the same kind, which mixes their characters in the offspring.

plain.en: the agent that carries the pollen

means.en: Whatever carries pollen from anther to stigma: wind, water, insects or birds.

plain.en: the tube that grows down the style

means.en: The tube a pollen grain grows after it lands on a stigma. It grows down through the style to the ovule and carries the male gamete.

plain.en: the seed leaving the parent

means.en: apart
to scatter
Seeds travelling away from the parent plant, by wind, water or animals.

plain.en: the seed starting to grow

means.en: to sprout
the act of
A seed beginning to grow into a new plant.

plain.en: the two gametes fusing into one

means.en: fruitful, bearing
The joining of two gametes into one cell, the zygote.

plain.en: eggs and sperm meeting in the water outside the body

means.en: Fertilisation in which eggs and sperm are released into water and meet there. Many aquatic animals, such as frogs and fish, do this.

plain.en: the egg held inside the mother's body

means.en: Fertilisation inside the female body, as in reptiles, birds and mammals.

plain.en: the organ where sperm are made

means.en: The male organ that makes sperm. Sperm form well only slightly below body temperature, and the testes sit in the scrotum outside the abdomen.

plain.en: a pouch of skin that keeps the testes cooler

means.en: The pouch of skin that holds the testes and keeps them slightly cooler than normal body temperature, which sperm formation needs.

plain.en: a long tube the sperm travel along

means.en: vessel
carrying away
The long tube that carries sperm from a testis. It opens into the urethra.

plain.en: a gland that adds a nourishing fluid

means.en: seed
A gland that adds fluid to the sperm. The fluid nourishes the sperm and helps them stay active and move.

plain.en: a gland that adds another fluid

means.en: before, in front of
to stand
A gland that also adds fluid, which nourishes the sperm and helps them stay active.

plain.en: one tube carrying both urine and sperm out

means.en: The common passage for urine and sperm in males. It runs through the penis.

plain.en: the tube from an ovary to the uterus (also called the fallopian tube)

means.en: egg
a channel
The tube that connects an ovary to the uterus. It moves the egg along, and a sperm may meet the egg here.

plain.en: the narrow neck below the uterus

means.en: neck
The narrow passage through which the uterus opens into the vagina.

plain.en: the bag-like part where a foetus develops

means.en: womb
A bag-like structure with a thick wall and a soft inner lining, where a foetus develops.

plain.en: the early stage growing from the fertilised egg

means.en: to swell, to sprout
The early stage that grows from a fertilised egg. In humans, major organs start forming in the first two months.

plain.en: the developing young, from about the ninth week

means.en: The name for the developing baby from about the ninth week of pregnancy.

plain.en: an egg being released

means.en: egg
to carry
The release of a mature egg from an ovary. Usually one egg is released each month, about 14 days before the next period.

plain.en: a period, the shedding of the lining

means.en: monthly
the act of
The shedding of the thick lining of the uterus, with some blood, when an egg is not fertilised. It usually lasts 3 to 7 days, and it is a sign of a healthy reproductive system.

plain.en: fertilising outside the body, in a dish

means.en: glass
the joining of two gametes
Combining an egg and a sperm outside the body, usually in a laboratory dish. The fertilised egg is then implanted in the uterus to begin a possible pregnancy.

plain.en: making new individuals

means.en: The biological process by which living things produce new individuals of their own kind.

plain.en: one parent, offspring the same as it

means.en: Reproduction by a single parent. The offspring are genetically identical to the parent.

plain.en: two parents, offspring a mix of both

means.en: Reproduction in which gametes from two parents join. The offspring inherit a mix of characters from both.

plain.en: where a leaf grows on a stem

means.en: The point on a stem from which a leaf grows.

plain.en: the stem between two nodes

means.en: The stretch of stem between two nodes.

plain.en: a tiny new plant on the parent

means.en: A tiny plant that grows on a parent plant, such as on the edge of a Bryophyllum leaf, and can grow into a new plant.

plain.en: joining a stem piece onto a rooted plant

means.en: Joining a stem piece of one plant into a slit in the stem of a rooted plant, so that the two grow as one.

plain.en: growing plants from tiny pieces in a jar

means.en: Growing new plants in a laboratory from a tiny piece of a plant, in a nutrient jelly. It gives many healthy plants, all copies of one parent.

plain.en: a small outgrowth

means.en: A small outgrowth. On yeast and hydra it enlarges and separates to live on its own. On a plant it opens into a leaf or a flower.

plain.en: making young as outgrowths

means.en: Asexual reproduction in which a bud grows on the parent and then separates.

plain.en: a one-celled fungus

means.en: A fungus made of a single cell. It reproduces by budding.

plain.en: a tiny water animal

means.en: A small multicellular animal that lives in fresh water. It reproduces by budding.

plain.en: a fungus made of threads

means.en: A fungus that grows as a mat of threads on moist food. It spreads by spores.

plain.en: a medicine against bacteria

means.en: A medicine that kills bacteria or stops them growing. Many antibiotics are made from moulds.

plain.en: differences among individuals

means.en: Differences between individuals of one kind, made by the mixing of chromosomes.

plain.en: the part of a cell that holds the chromosomes

means.en: The part of a cell that holds the chromosomes.

plain.en: the material of genes

means.en: The substance that carries genetic information in chromosomes.

plain.en: the female gamete

means.en: The female gamete. In a flower, each ovule has one egg cell. In humans, the ovaries make the eggs.

plain.en: one ring of parts in a flower

means.en: One ring of parts around the centre of a flower. Sepals form the outermost whorl.

plain.en: dust-like grain made by an anther

means.en: A tiny grain made by the anther. It contains the male gamete.

plain.en: crossing plants by hand

means.en: Removing the stamens from a flower, bagging it, and transferring chosen pollen by hand.

plain.en: the sweet liquid in a flower

means.en: A sweet liquid in flowers. Insects and birds feed on it.

plain.en: choosing the best plants to breed

means.en: Farmers select plants with wanted characters for reproduction.

plain.en: putting a wanted character into DNA

means.en: Inserting the genetic material for a wanted character into the DNA of a chosen variety.

plain.en: food stored in an egg

means.en: Food stored inside an egg that feeds the developing embryo.

plain.en: a young feeding stage

means.en: The feeding stage that hatches from some eggs, such as a caterpillar. It later changes into the adult.

plain.en: the stage before an adult butterfly

means.en: The stage between larva and adult, when the body changes.

plain.en: the male gamete in animals

means.en: The male gamete. Each sperm has a head containing genetic material and a long tail that helps it swim.

plain.en: an animal that feeds its young on milk

means.en: An animal, such as a cow or a human, in which the young grow inside the mother and are fed on her milk after birth.

plain.en: making sperm and eggs

means.en: The formation of gametes, by meiosis, in the testes and the ovaries.

plain.en: a chemical that regulates body functions

means.en: A chemical that regulates different functions in the body, such as sperm production and the changes of puberty.

plain.en: the male organ the urethra runs through

means.en: The male organ through which the urethra runs.

plain.en: the passage from the uterus to outside

means.en: The passage that leads from the uterus, through the cervix, to the outside of the body.

plain.en: the ball of cells settling into the lining

means.en: The zygote, now a ball of cells, sinks into the lining of the uterus and receives nourishment from it. This marks the beginning of pregnancy.

plain.en: when the body starts to mature

means.en: The time when the reproductive organs mature and begin producing gametes.

plain.en: the monthly cycle

means.en: The repeating cycle of ovulation, preparation of the uterus and menstruation.

plain.en: when monthly cycles stop

means.en: The time, around age 50, when the menstrual cycle stops.

plain.en: X or Y

means.en: One of the two chromosomes that decide the sex of a baby. Females have XX and males have XY.

plain.en: one of the three stages of pregnancy

means.en: Pregnancy lasts about nine months and is divided into three stages called trimesters.

plain.en: the link between mother and baby in the uterus

means.en: The part through which food and oxygen pass from the mother to the baby, by way of the cord.

plain.en: the way out of the uterus at birth

means.en: The path through the cervix and the vagina by which a baby is born.

plain.en: anxiety and tiredness after a birth

means.en: A recognised, treatable condition in which a mother feels anxious, tired or low after a baby is born.

plain.en: a community health worker

means.en: An Accredited Social Health Activist: a woman trained to promote hygiene, immunisation and family planning under the National Health Mission.

plain.en: the years between child and adult

means.en: The stage of life in which the body changes and becomes capable of reproduction.

plain.en: the body becoming able to reproduce

means.en: A gradual change in adolescence in which the body becomes capable of reproduction.

plain.en: preventing pregnancy

means.en: A method that helps prevent pregnancy, such as condoms, oral pills or an IUD.

plain.en: a barrier that stops sperm and infections

means.en: A barrier that stops sperm from reaching the egg. It also helps prevent the spread of infections.

plain.en: a small device placed in the uterus

means.en: A device such as the copper-T, placed in the uterus to avoid pregnancy. It may sometimes irritate the uterus.

plain.en: one kind of IUD

means.en: An Intra-Uterine Device placed in the uterus to avoid pregnancy.

plain.en: infections passed through sexual contact

means.en: Infections that pass from an infected person to an uninfected person through close sexual contact, such as gonorrhoea, herpes, syphilis, genital warts and HIV.

plain.en: one of the sexually transmitted infections

means.en: A virus that is one of the sexually transmitted infections. It can eventually lead to AIDS.

plain.en: a disease HIV can lead to

means.en: A disease of the body’s defences that HIV can eventually lead to.

plain.en: a sexually transmitted infection

means.en: One of the sexually transmitted infections.

plain.en: a sexually transmitted infection

means.en: One of the sexually transmitted infections.

plain.en: a sexually transmitted infection

means.en: One of the sexually transmitted infections.

plain.en: a sexually transmitted infection

means.en: One of the sexually transmitted infections.

plain.en: removing a pregnancy by surgery

means.en: A procedure to remove a pregnancy by surgery, generally only within the first trimester. The law allows it only under set conditions, and only with a qualified doctor.

plain.en: the young of a parent

means.en: The new individuals produced by a parent or parents.

plain.en: a group of similar cells

means.en: A group of similar cells that work together.

plain.en: a plant with plantlets on its leaves

means.en: A plant with fleshy leaves. Tiny plantlets grow on the edges of its leaves.

plain.en: tiny one-celled living things

means.en: Very small living things, each a single cell.

plain.en: a one-celled living thing

means.en: A living thing made of a single cell that has no fixed shape.

plain.en: moulds, yeast and their relatives

means.en: A group of living things that includes moulds and yeast.

plain.en: still able to live or work

means.en: Still alive and able to do its work. An unfertilised human egg stays viable for about a day.

plain.en: a flower with all four parts

means.en: A flower with sepals, petals, stamens and pistil.

plain.en: a water plant

means.en: A plant that grows in water. Its pollen is carried by water.

plain.en: a water plant

means.en: A plant that grows in water. Its pollen is carried by water.

plain.en: an idea to test

means.en: A possible explanation that can be tested by observation or experiment.

plain.en: a young frog

means.en: The young stage that hatches from a frog's egg and lives in water.

plain.en: madar, a wild shrub

means.en: A shrub whose seeds carry fine hairs and float on the wind. In India it is also called madar.

plain.en: a part of the body that makes a fluid

means.en: A part of the body that makes and releases a fluid. The seminal vesicles and the prostate are glands.
